purpose: Companion model built for interpretation, not forecasting. The 24-variable ridge model in fit.js is the predictor; this exists to give a coefficient vector that can be read.
units: points of scoring margin per standard deviation of edge

selection.method: greedy forward, hard sign-stability gate across walk-forward folds

walk_forward.note: Optimistic: the variable set was chosen with sight of every fold. See nested_walk_forward for the unbiased figure.

nested_walk_forward.note: Selection redone inside each fold. This is the honest number.
